targetTest: post-silence shadow replay leaves the REST flood after duplicate version 7
expected: After version 7 reported normal water level 2, two missed heartbeat periods let REST report flood level 31. A duplicate version 7 replay on the still-open connection must leave water level 31, REST ownership (shadowVersion undefined), shadowSilent true, receivedAt 1787920200000, and arrival anchor 1787918400000.
actual: The duplicate replay changed water level to 2, restored shadowVersion 7, cleared shadowSilent, and moved receivedAt and the arrival anchor to 1787920200001.
semanticAssessment: The active named runtime-to-store regression compiled and executed exactly one case against unchanged production accountRuntime and state blobs from committed HEAD 53afb509cb5cccabcbaf1280c132c2b5b7a1d9b4. Its preflight assertion proved REST flood level 31 and silent handoff before replay. The intended post-replay deepStrictEqual failed on unsafe normal telemetry, shadow ownership, silence trust, receipt, and anchor. This is a product behavior failure, not a build, fixture, runner, or environment failure. A separate unversioned telemetry case independently failed on the same safety boundary and is recorded below.
